summary: Parses a configuration/command string using two delimiter types into a 5-byte output record: copies the input string a1 into a local buffer, walks delimited segments via sub_5897CA using the primary delimiter byte_5C3F6C (bounded copies into v12 and v11 via sub_587DD0), then walks sub-segments with the secondary delimiter word_5BEB48, converting each segment to a byte via sub_587ECE. The word result is stored at a2 + 2 and the four byte results at a2 + 4 through a2 + 7. Returns 1 when every segment lookup succeeds; any null segment result returns 0 early.

Parse a third sub-segment with sub_5897CA(0, &word_5BEB48); when null, return 0 immediately, then convert it to a byte with sub_587ECE into v7.
Parse a fourth sub-segment with sub_5897CA(0, &word_5BEB48); when null, return 0 immediately, then convert it to a byte with sub_587ECE for direct storage at a2 + 7.
Write the parsed results into the output record: a word from sub_587ECE(v11) at a2 + 2, and bytes v14, v10, v7, and the a2 + 7 value at a2 + 4 through a2 + 7.
Return 1 when all segment lookups succeeded; return 0 on any null segment lookup.
